verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics for the send endpoint. The webhook retry behavior describes MailerSend retrying deliveries to your endpoint, not safe client retries of sends. The x-message-id is a status-tracking identifier, not a deduplication key, so both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can retry a failed send safely — idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics guarantee a network timeout never double-sends a receipt
